judgment_text:
[Crime No. 4 of 2022]

Prayer : appeal filed under Section 415(2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha, to call for the records pertaining to the impugned judgment of conviction passed by the Sessions Judge, Special Court for Exclusive Trial of POCSO Act, Tirunelveli in Spl CC. No. 58 of 2022 dated 25-9-2024 and set aside the same and to acquit the appellant/accused from all the charges framed against him

When this criminal appeal is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the appellant and the learned government advocate appearing for the respondent submit that the appellant died on 27-11-2025. They have also produced the death certificate.

2. Recording the above submission this appeal is closed as charges abated. Consequently connected miscellaneous petition is also closed.
